WITH qualified_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID 
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND l."U-PRO" != '-'
),
patient_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    COALESCE(p.SEX, '') as sex_group,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN l.ALP IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0
      THEN CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / CAST(l.GPT AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualified_patients)
  GROUP BY p.ID, sex_group
)
SELECT 
  sex_group as SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_alp_to_gpt_ratio
FROM patient_metrics
GROUP BY sex_group
ORDER BY sex_group
